explication: This repository is a curated public-API catalog, with README.md as the product surface and Python validators as its quality layer. The principal workflow is: a developer browses the catalog, selects an API capability, calls the external REST service with its credentials, and receives domain data. Contributors maintain catalog formatting and link health through scripts/validate. The sampled code shows validation orchestration and HTTP link checking; API implementations themselves are external and not present in this repository.
